{"id":1584604836,"question_id":3430,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1742833269,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"63 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1584604836/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Days Without Meetings","memory":"126.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countDays(int days, vector<vector<int>>& meetings) {\n        sort(meetings.begin() , meetings.end());\n        int start = 0;\n        int end  = 0;\n        int offdays = 0;\n\n        for(int i=0 ;i<meetings.size(); i++)\n        {\n            int next_start_time = meetings[i][0];\n            int next_end_time = meetings[i][1];\n\n            if(next_start_time > end)\n            {\n                offdays += next_start_time - end - 1;\n            }\n            end = max(end , next_end_time);\n        }\n        if(days > end)\n        {\n            offdays += days - end;\n        }\n    return offdays;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-days-without-meetings","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":497}
